instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: Helix is a digital health platform for chronic disease management, specifically focusing on diabetes and hypertension. It integrates data from continuous glucose monitors (CGMs) and blood pressure cuffs with AI coaching modules to personalize medication adherence and lifestyle recommendations. The company manages the care journey for 25,000 active patients through robust partnerships with over 40 clinical sites.
answers.pastInitiatives: We successfully launched a digital customer onboarding flow last quarter that reduced average onboarding time from 12 days to 5 days. This cross-functional project involved seamless coordination between product development, compliance review, and customer success teams. Early NPS scores for new customers onboarded through this flow are 22 points higher than the legacy process.
answers.strategicGoals: Customer retention has declined from 92% to 84% over the past 18 months, primarily among our mid-tier and enterprise segments. We need to urgently modernize our customer-facing technology and proactively address the specific pain points driving churn before the trend becomes irreversible by improving self-service capabilities.
answers.additionalContext: The primary challenge is integrating disparate data streams securely and ensuring compliance with evolving patient data privacy regulations across different operational geographies.
answers.teamSize: Innovation is decentralized across business units, each with its own innovation lead and dedicated resources, coordinated by a group-level Chief Innovation Officer. The total innovation workforce is approximately 100 people across the organization. A group innovation fund of €5M annually is allocated competitively — business units pitch for funding against clear innovation KPIs including revenue from new products and process efficiency gains.

opportunities.title: Streamline Data Integration Pipeline (Process Focus)
opportunities.rationale: Improving the back-end data ingestion and processing pipeline will reduce latency in delivering real-time insights to care coaches. This incremental change directly addresses operational inefficiencies identified during internal audits, strengthening core service delivery.

first_actions: Conduct a formal process mapping workshop for the current data flow.
Pilot an automated ETL tool implementation for one major data stream.
resources_needed: Software licensing for new integration middleware
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduction in average data processing latency by 30% within Q3.
milestones: Q2: Process mapping complete and prioritized backlog finalized.
Q3: Pilot implementation of the ETL tool successful.

opportunities.title: Hyper-Personalized Predictive Deterioration Engine (Product Focus)
opportunities.rationale: Developing an advanced AI model capable of anticipating patient health deterioration days in advance using multi-modal data streams will create a significant competitive moat. This radical move shifts the product from reactive coaching to proactive intervention, which is essential for retaining enterprise clients.

first_actions: Establish an internal 'AI Defense' task force with cross-functional leads.
Secure a dedicated data science talent contract.
resources_needed: GPU computing infrastructure costs ($50k initial investment)
execution_plan.success_metric: Increase in predictive alert accuracy by 40% compared to current models.
milestones: Q1: Model architecture defined and data pipeline secured.
Q3: Beta testing of the new predictive engine with 5,000 active patients.

opportunities.title: Enhanced Self-Service Patient Portal (Platform Focus)
opportunities.rationale: Investing in modernizing the patient portal interface and simplifying access to coaching resources will reduce support tickets and improve user engagement, directly addressing churn drivers related to poor digital self-service tools.

first_actions: Run rapid A/B testing on the redesigned navigation flow.
Prioritize UX improvements based on top 5 customer pain points identified in informal feedback.
execution_plan.success_metric: Increase in portal feature adoption rate by 25% and reduction in support tickets related to navigation by 15%.
milestones: Q4: Full rollout of the modernized portal across all geographies.

next_steps.action: Establish a dedicated, cross-functional 'Market Defense' steering committee to review the predictive engine roadmap.
Initiate detailed cost analysis and feasibility study for the Hyper-Personalized Predictive Deterioration Engine (Radical opportunity).
Define standardized 'Process' documentation templates to streamline cross-departmental innovation intake.

key_weaknesses: Decentralized innovation efforts lead to inconsistent feature prioritization and redundant development across business units.
Low digital maturity (4) hinders the scalability of complex AI initiatives and creates friction in adopting new automated processes.
Reliance on informal feedback makes it difficult to prioritize product roadmaps based on quantifiable customer needs rather than anecdotal evidence.
